verdict.rationale: Formant docs describe event-triggered webhooks ("make an API call to any endpoint over HTTP based on a trigger from a Formant event") and automated incident-response/alerting for anomalies, which directly support rule-based automatic actions on events. However, there's no detailed documentation of a full rules/condition-builder UI, complex logic composition, or independent corroboration of this feature working at scale. Missing for 10: detailed rule-definition interface/logic docs, independent/hands-on validation, examples of multi-condition or chained automations.
